summary: Discusses how Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) coding and congestion control can work together. FEC adds redundancy to help with losses at the end of transfers or on networks with non-congestion loss, but it must not hide congestion signals. The memo offers guidance on letting both coexist. It is informational.
